plans.name: Duplicate-line split
plans.idea: The shop prices duplicate SKUs through a map that keeps only one line, while fulfilment sums every raw line.

plans.name: Enlarge after approval
plans.idea: Creating another order with an already-approved order's reference may mutate its stored lines after PayPal fixed the approved amount at $64, without creating or approving a new PayPal amount.

plans.name: Captured-order transplant
plans.idea: The capture handler may trust a client-supplied shop reference, or the latest pending order in the session, after finding that the supplied old PayPal order is already COMPLETED, instead of using the immutable PayPal-order-to-shop-order binding created at checkout.

plans.name: Webhook payment transplant
plans.idea: The webhook handler may look up the order solely from resource.custom_id and record idempotency per shop order, rather than per capture ID, while revalidating the genuine capture ID with PayPal instead of relying only on the signature.

plans.name: Capture-result spoof
plans.idea: For an unapproved order, the capture handler may trust status, capture ID, or amount fields supplied in the capture request body, or use them as a fallback when PayPal refuses the capture.

plans.name: Create-order mass assignment
plans.idea: The create-order handler may copy unknown top-level body fields into the stored order record, allowing the client to set its payment or fulfilment state directly.
